text:
Maria Gonzalez: Hey support, escalation from ACME — multiple users in their GitHub org are failing to complete SSO. They hit our /auth/callback and we return a 400 with a state mismatch. Repro steps below, they say it started after they started using a URL shortener for the invite links. :frowning:

Maria Gonzalez: Repro steps they provided:
1) Click org invite link (shortened)
2) Redirect -> GitHub SSO
3) After auth, GitHub redirects back to https://app.redwood.example.com/auth/callback with code+state
4) Our callback sometimes sees the state truncated or decodes to invalid JSON -> state mismatch

Samir Patel: Do we have the raw callback query we can look at? Also which redirect_uri is registered on the GH app? Could be trailing slash mismatch.

Maria Gonzalez: Attached example from their webserver logs (sanitized):

`GET /auth/callback?code=abcd1234&state=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.e30.eyJtYWMiOiJyZWR3b29k`  <-- note state ends mid-segment

And another one that succeeds:

`GET /auth/callback?code=efgh5678&state=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.e30.eyJtYWMiOiJyZWR3b29kQmFzZTY0`

Samir Patel: Huh — that looks like the state is being clipped. Could be link shortener or a proxy rewriting the query. Can you paste the registered redirect URI for their GitHub app? Also any CDN/proxy in front that might strip query length?

Maria Gonzalez: Registered redirect: `https://app.redwood.example.com/auth/callback` (no trailing slash). They have CloudFront -> Fastly -> our LB. They confirmed the shortener expands to a URL with a trailing slash sometimes, and one of their intermediate proxies has a 2048 char limit.

Jordan Lee: Two likely failure modes: (1) state param being truncated by a proxy (as Maria suggests); (2) +/- vs space encoding issue: some link shorteners or mail clients turn `+` into space. Our state is base64url-ish; if a space lands in it, url decode may yield wrong length/padding and JSON parse fails. We should defensively normalize before decoding: replace ' ' -> '+' and re-pad base64 when missing.

Jordan Lee: Also check PKCE verifier length in session store. If the state is decoded but the stored PKCE challenge doesn't match due to cookie/sameSite or cookie chunking, we see similar failures.

Maria Gonzalez: I grabbed the request headers from failing requests — cookie looks present but we see `Cookie: session=eyJ...` split across two header lines on one trace (looks like chunking). Example snippet:

```
Host: app.redwood.example.com
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0
Cookie: session=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.e30
Cookie: session_part2=eyJtYWMiOiJyZWR3b29k
```

Alex Kim: :eyes: That cookie chunking + proxy trimming + shortener whitespace could all combine. I was able to reproduce locally by forcing a shortener that replaces `%2B` with space and splitting the session cookie. Staging returns 400 + "state_mismatch".

Alex Kim: Quick mitigation we can give customer: ask their admins to disable shortener for SSO links or configure the shortener to preserve `%2B`/`+` encoding. Also ask to ensure no intermediate proxy strips query length. For an immediate workaround, they can use the non-shortened invite link.

Support Bot: Created ticket INC-2026 and attached traces. :lock:

Jordan Lee: Plan: implement normalization in auth middleware — normalize state param by url-decoding, replace spaces with '+', attempt base64 padding up to multiple of 4 before decode. Also add diagnostics: log state length and a truncated-flag metric. I'll open a PR and target a canary deploy to Dedicated later today.

Jordan Lee: Also add a fallback check: if session cookie is chunked, attempt to reassemble from session_part* headers before rejecting. That should reduce false negatives.

Maria Gonzalez: Great. Customer wants ETA to share with their SREs. Can we put a quick ETA in the ticket?

Alex Kim: I can draft a small patch and test in staging in the next 3-4 hours. If tests pass, we can ship to canary and provide an ETA of ~6 hours for canary + 24 hours for full roll (if no issues). I'll post the PR link when ready. :+1:

Maria Gonzalez: Thank you — I'll update the customer with the workaround and ETA. Please ping here when PR is up so I can include it in the update. :pray:

Support Bot: Note: last failure events from ACME show 42 distinct user failures in the last 12h, majority concentrated during the invite email campaign (possible correlation with shortener).
